freshness_acknowledgements.reason: The 2026-08-01 win-transition fix adds an OPTIONAL parameter `win_transition=None` to `_transitions_block` / `induce_prompt` / both proposers' `induce`, plus a `_win_transition` field on E3AgentPolicy and one call site passing it. freshness_acknowledgements.reason: The 2026-08-01 attempt-budget fix adds a DEFAULT-OFF flag, CARNOT_ARC_INDUCE_DEFECT_OWNS_ATTEMPTS. With it unset -- the shipped state -- a defect re-ask consumes an attempt exactly as before and the induce loop is behaviourally identical to the path this artifact was produced under. Only with the flag SET does a defect re-ask grant an extra attempt instead of consuming a content attempt.
freshness_acknowledgements.evidence: PROVEN BY TEST, in the direction that matters for this artifact. tests/python/test_arc_defect_gate_attempt_consumption_2026_08_01.py asserts BOTH directions: with the flag OFF the prior behaviour reproduces exactly -- including the bug, so a content-failure sequence still yields zero defect re-asks -- and only with it ON does the gate fire. The OFF assertion is the load-bearing one here: it is what makes the shipped default a true no-op rather than an approximation of one. A clean answer is additionally asserted to cost exactly one call in BOTH modes. No rebuild differential was run for this change and none is claimed.
